description: A production-grade inference engine that classifies multilingual social media comments — English, Hindi, Hinglish, emojis, political memes and sarcasm — into sentiment, content moderation, stance and custom tasks. Local LLM inference via Ollama (Qwen3.5-9B / DeepSeek-V4-Pro) with one-token logprob letter readout, cyclic option-order debiasing, Platt temperature scaling and post-context KV prompt caching. FastAPI service with a web GUI and a Tkinter desktop GUI.
displayTitle: Calibrated Probability Engine for Social Media Intelligence
name: Moj
tagline: High-throughput, calibrated classification for multilingual social media comments.

description: Exploratory analysis of 6,362,620 transactions across 11 columns, with full documentation in Markdown, PDF and HTML. The headline finding in the notebook's own docs: 100% of fraud sits in TRANSFER (4,097 cases) and CASH_OUT (4,116 cases).
name: jiraba
notes: PaySim is synthetic mobile-money simulation data — not real UPI transactions. No README in the repo; documented from its INDEX.md.
tagline: A 54-cell EDA and feature-engineering notebook on the PaySim dataset.

description: Built on Scrapling. A fast API engine (Fetcher with curl-cffi TLS fingerprint spoofing) and a stealth browser engine (StealthySession / Camoufox, Cloudflare solving) extract profiles, posts, media items, comments and likes. Adaptive Gaussian delays, exponential backoff on HTTP 429, proxy pool rotation, cookie support, and a CLI with JSON/CSV export.
name: grabber
tagline: Undetectable, high-performance Instagram scraping with a dual-engine design.

description: A high-throughput pipeline that scrapes, archives and structures YouTube video and community data at scale. Producer-Consumer architecture with an atomic SQLite task queue (WAL mode) and a native InnerTube Community Extractor. Click CLI: scrape, produce, consume, status, retry-failed, community.
name: fai
tagline: Videos, audio, transcripts, comments, community posts and polls — multi-threaded and resumable.

description: QLoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on the IN-Abs Indian Supreme Court dataset, run on an NVIDIA RTX 5050 laptop GPU (8.55 GB VRAM, CUDA 12.8, PyTorch 2.11). The full 2-epoch run (EXP-003, 1,395 pairs, 176 steps) improved on both the zero-shot baseline and the 1-epoch pilot, with max_seq_len pinned at 1280 to stay inside dedicated VRAM.
displayTitle: QLoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-4B on IN-Abs
name: LegalTrace-Finetuning
notes: This repo is the fine-tuning work only; the main LegalTrace app is a team repo (github.com/akshata-patel30/LegalTrace).
tagline: Adapting Qwen3-4B on Indian Supreme Court judgments to write structured legal headnotes.

description: An air-gapped workstation for transforming intelligence into deliverables: ingestion of PDF, DOCX, PPTX, scanned OCR, 4K video and audio; a provenance kernel linking every output sentence to exact character offsets in the source; a tamper-evident SHA-256 audit chain and AES-256-GCM encrypted disk. Also includes an AIZ-Infographic Engine (7 air-gapped themes) and the HyperFrames motion video engine.
name: Venu
tagline: A defense-grade GenAI content transformation platform with zero network egress.

description: An enterprise sales-operations platform: dual-ceiling discount governance (customer tier caps and product category ceilings), automated multi-depot fulfillment routing, calendar-day subscription proration, and a negotiation loop that re-routes policy-breaching counter-offers into managerial approval. NestJS backend, Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL + Prisma, pnpm monorepo, Docker.

tagline: Configure, Price, Quote with discount governance, multi-warehouse inventory and hybrid billing.

description: Built for the Into the Scrape-Verse hackathon. Monitors whole fleets of scrapers around the clock, detects silent drift with a 4-layer validation engine, synthesises deterministic AI prompts from stored field intent, executes autonomous repair via `bdata scraper heal`, verifies the fix with mandatory post-heal re-validation, and keeps verifiable audit logs with rollback safety.
name: spyderverse
tagline: 4-layer drift validation and closed-loop self-healing for Bright Data Scraper Studio.

description: Combines the WiderPerson dataset with a license-plate dataset (260,186 human instances vs 41,846 plates, ~6.2:1) and trains a YOLO26s detector: 4x oversampling of plate-containing images, focal loss, mosaic + mixup + copy-paste augmentation, 1280px input for tiny-plate recall, 150 epochs.
name: ProjectArgus
notes: No README in the repo and no results published — described from the training script only. No accuracy or results are claimed.
tagline: Dataset preparation and training pipeline for humans vs license plates.

description: Synchronises cockpit radio audio with FastF1 telemetry to decode driver cognitive load at 340 km/h. Whisper speech-to-text, a Wav2Vec2 MSP-DIM continuous emotion engine, and a custom Tone-Detector-F1 classifier sort the driver into STRESSED, TIRED or CALM states on a live pit-wall dashboard. FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend.

name: GPHacakthon26
notes: Most-starred repo on the profile (2 stars).
tagline: Real-time Formula 1 vocal stress intelligence aligned with millisecond telemetry.
